wiki_article:
**Sharks Ark record #969** is a superseded v2.1 version witness whose recovered body does not match the version the deposit was meant to preserve.

The historical record title identifies a **Receivability Patch** between v2.0 and later Consensus Constraint and Text-First revisions. The intended v2.1 bytes were not recovered. Instead, restoration from an authorial blog surface seated a later v3.0 Sharks Ark body.

That body declares the Book of Revelation and the Space Ark structurally identical within the Sharks variant. It maps Revelation into identity, topology, operations, witnesses, governance, canon, and runtime; treats imperative verbs as operators; reads the seven churches as diagnostic stations; installs a Liberatory Operator Set; and separates runtime-visible textual claims from variant readings and high-risk historical reconstruction.

The body also proposes Josephus as the author behind “John,” a sevenfold planetary mapping, a numismatic 666 reading, and Revelation-first derivation claims. These are tiered inside the work as reconstruction or variant claims rather than requirements for the interpretive runtime.

Because v3.0 is seated in a v2.1 record, the body may be read as a restoration witness but may not serve as the canonical v2.1 text. The series now points to the independently restored v3.0 at deposit #1101.
